meta.title: Electronic Invoice (Hóa Đơn Điện Tử) — Test Cases

coverage_gaps: Integration tests: invoice endpoint coverage + concurrency test for sequence uniqueness
Frontend unit tests: invoice list filters, VAT subtotals display
E2E: accountant invoice list and filter flow

unit.description: handleOrderProcessing() listener creates invoice in 'draft' state when order.processing event fires
invoiceNumber format is '{YYYY}/{sequence:06d}' — e.g. '2026/000001' for first invoice (LEGAL-01)
Invoice sequence increments per-store per-year — store A and store B have independent sequences (BR-INV-02)
vatVnd = floor(taxableVnd × rate / 100) — integer arithmetic, no decimals (BR-INV-05)
VAT subtotals grouped by tax rate: order with 8% + 10% items produces 2 subtotal entries (BR-INV-04)
Invoice lines use OrderItem snapshot values — NOT live Product table values (BR-INV-03)
Invoice includes: invoiceNumber, storeId, orderId, issuedAt, lines[], vatSubtotals, totalVnd (LEGAL-04)
After invoice created successfully → order.status transitions to 'completed' (BR-ORDER-06)
cancel() with invoice in 'issued' state and order in 'refunded' → invoice.status='cancelled', invoiceNumber UNCHANGED (LEGAL-05)
cancel() when order is NOT in 'refunded' state → 409 'Order must be refunded before cancelling invoice' (BR-INV-08)
cancel() is idempotent — already-cancelled invoice returns 200 without error

integration.description: GET /api/v1/orders/:id/invoice → 200 with full invoice after order is completed; → 404 while order still pending
GET /api/v1/orders/:id/invoice → 404 cross-store isolation: store A's invoice not accessible by store B's user
GET /api/v1/invoices → 200 paginated list by accountant; → 403 when called by cashier (BR-INV-06, BR-INV-07)
GET /api/v1/invoices?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD → returns only invoices within date range
PATCH /api/v1/invoices/:id/cancel → 200 after refund; → 409 if order not refunded; → 403 for cashier
Concurrency: two simultaneous confirm-payment calls for same store produce invoices with unique sequential numbers (pessimistic lock via FOR UPDATE)
integration.notes: Critical for legal compliance. Run with 2 parallel requests. Sequence must not skip or duplicate.

e2e.description: Cashier completes POS order → invoice number appears in confirmation screen — full browser flow
Accountant logs in → /invoices → filters by date range → views invoice detail with VAT subtotals displayed

frontend_unit.description: useInvoices hook: fetches paginated invoice list; applies from/to date filter params correctly
InvoiceDetail component: renders vatSubtotals table correctly — one row per tax rate group
InvoiceDetail component: all monetary values displayed as integer VNĐ with thousands separator (LEGAL-06)
Cancel invoice button: visible only for accountant role; cashier does not see cancel action (BR-INV-06)

vat_calculation_reference.description: Reference calculation per wiki/features/invoice.json VAT example
